entities.summary: The Les Kurbas Lviv Academic Theater was founded in 1988 by Volodymyr Kuchynsky and a group of young actors who, like the outstanding Ukrainian director Les Kurbas and his colleagues in 1918, felt the need to create a theater. Many of those younger actors previously performed at the Maria Zankovetska Theatre in Lviv. Oleh Mykhailovych Tsyona has been the artistic director of the Les Kurbas Theatre since 2019.
